name: FE and API news, feeds, component
description:
# Context

We have FE and API news as Feeds 

. 
We want to keep up the status quo. See [https://developers.shoptet.com/](https://developers.shoptet.com/)

# Task

Blog is implemented here: [https://shoptet-developers.vercel.app/news](https://shoptet-developers.vercel.app/news)

[https://docusaurus.io/docs/blog](https://docusaurus.io/docs/blog)

Implement Blog posts that will the same as the current FE and API news. It is time, sensitive page (containing date). There are two main categories, `Frontend news` and `API news`.
Create a widget (component) that will show only N last posts

It should copy the [https://developers.shoptet.com/category/api/](https://developers.shoptet.com/category/api/) and [https://developers.shoptet.com/frontend](https://developers.shoptet.com/frontend).
